exposure: Timing of oxytocin discontinuation during labor
cohort: 10,421 singleton pregnancies between 24 and 42 weeks gestation who reached the second stage of labor and received oxytocin
finding: Discontinuation of oxytocin ≥30 minutes prior to delivery was associated with a higher rate of postpartum hemorrhage overall, but a lower rate among vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Among vaginal deliveries, discontinuation of oxytocin ≥30 minutes prior to delivery was associated with a lower rate of postpartum hemorrhage.
